name: Raj Lalsare
summaryHtml: Raj founded Cohort Science™ with a conviction that higher education deserves rigorous, data-driven intelligence on par with financial services and strategy consulting. Read more.
bioHtml:
Founded Cohort Science™ with a clear conviction that higher education deserves the same quality of rigorous, data-driven intelligence that guides decisions in financial services and strategy consulting. A seasoned analytics and business transformation leader, he has driven enterprise-wide capability building across multiple organizations, most notably as Head of Analytics at a leading online education firm, where he established sector-leading data science functions at scale.

Earlier, as a consultant at Oliver Wyman, he advised organizations across complex business transformation mandates. An alumnus of Cambridge University, he holds degrees in Production Engineering, Operations Research, and Business Administration.

name: Bill Lowery
summaryHtml: Bill brings a career-long record of senior leadership across leading higher education companies, with a focus on enrollment growth and student outcomes. Read more.
bioHtml:
Joined Cohort Science™ in 2024 with an extensive record of senior leadership across some of the world's leading higher education companies. Career-long focus on enrollment growth, student outcomes, and the expansion of affordable, high-quality, workforce-relevant education.

Brings a strategic approach grounded in data-driven insight, applied consistently to improve institutional performance, student experience, and educational outcomes.

name: Lauren Jensen
summaryHtml: Lauren is an executive higher education leader with proven success across enrollment, financial aid, planning, and analytics. Read more.
bioHtml:
An executive leader in higher education with proven success across enrollment, financial aid, planning, and analytics. As Founding Principal of ARC Insights, LLC, advises executives on strategy and measurable outcomes. Prior roles as VP for Enrollment Strategy at Calvin University (MI) and Thompson Rivers University (BC) delivered repeated enrollment growth and institutional revenue gains.

Joined Cohort Science™ in 2026, bringing over twenty years of higher education leadership experience across public and private universities, with a focus on helping education organizations and senior leaders develop effective strategies to navigate the evolving higher education and enrollment landscape.

name: Jenn Kanellis
summaryHtml: Jenn is a revenue growth executive and strategic partnerships leader with more than 20 years of experience across higher education and B2B sales. Read more.
bioHtml:
Jenn Kanellis is a revenue growth executive and strategic partnerships leader with more than 20 years of experience at the intersection of higher education and B2B sales. Grounded in a foundation as a former Chief Enrollment Officer — with deep expertise in enrollment strategy, student success, and institutional outcomes — Jenn has translated that insider knowledge into a track record of driving significant, measurable revenue growth for edtech and enrollment marketing companies.

Over the course of her career, Jenn has built and scaled partnerships with more than 300 colleges and universities across the U.S., developing a rare ability to sell, consult, and close with both senior enrollment leaders and C-suite stakeholders. Her roles at organizations including Niche, RaiseMe, and 3 Enrollment Marketing sharpened her expertise in go-to-market strategy, enterprise account growth, and building the kind of trusted relationships that convert to long-term revenue.

As a Fractional CRO at Cohort Science, Jenn brings that same lens to clients — helping edtech and higher ed-adjacent companies build scalable revenue engines, identify high-value partnership opportunities, and grow with strategic intention.

name: David Rheams, PhD
summaryHtml: David works at the intersection of academic research, corporate strategy, and product innovation to drive revenue, retention, and responsible growth. Read more.
bioHtml:
A practitioner at the intersection of academic research, corporate strategy, and product innovation. Currently serves as Senior Business Architect at Atlassian and Adjunct Professor at UT Dallas, integrating research with product development to build business strategies that drive revenue, retention, and responsible innovation.

Holds a PhD in Cultural Studies from George Mason University, with a focus on the intersection of science, software, and communication. Over 15 years of startup leadership experience at companies including LTK and ReachLocal, with a consistent record of scaling operations while maintaining a people-first approach.

name: Garima Singh
summaryHtml: Garima brings investment banking rigor and leads Cohort Science™'s economic mobility analysis product for actionable client strategy. Read more.
bioHtml:
Brings over five years of investment banking experience to her role as Associate of Strategy and Analysis at Cohort Science™. Her background spans global equity markets, credit ratings, and quantitative research, work that demanded both deep financial rigor and the ability to deliver insights under pressure. Earlier career experience includes managerial roles and collaboration with high-growth startups, building strong instincts for both analytical structure and organizational agility.

Garima has built and leads the economic mobility analysis product, designing the models, dashboards, and workflows that enable clients to understand their position and chart a path forward. Works closely with clients to translate complex datasets into growth opportunities and actionable strategies. Holds an MBA in Financial Market Practices and an MS in Business Analytics and AI from the University of Texas at Dallas.

name: Anjali Poonia
summaryHtml: Anjali supports analytical modeling and research, bringing data analytics and business intelligence experience across U.S. and European markets. Read more.
bioHtml:
Supports analytical modeling and research across Cohort Science™ engagements. Prior to joining Cohort Science™, built progressive experience in data analytics and business intelligence at Axtria, working with pharmaceutical and healthcare clients across European and US markets.

Holds a Master of Science in Mathematics from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Jodhpur and is currently pursuing an MBA with a concentration in Business Analytics and AI at the University of Texas at Dallas.

name: David Daniels
summaryHtml: David brings more than 25 years of leadership across higher education, K-12, CTE, and workforce development. Read more.
bioHtml:
David Daniels brings more than 25 years of leadership across higher education, K-12, career and technical education, and workforce development, with a focus on expanding access to affordable, high-quality learning and improving student persistence and completion. A seasoned operator, advisor, investor, and board member, he has helped institutions and education companies build, scale, and transform models across both traditional and non-traditional learning environments.

He most recently served as founding and interim President of a Great Books college, helping build its institutional infrastructure, enrollment strategy, go-to-market approach, and accreditation pathway. Previously, he was CEO, President, investor, and board member at Acadeum, and earlier served as President of Academic Partnerships, now Risepoint, and led managed services for Pearson's North American Higher Education business. He has also led buy-side diligence for private equity firms and advised education and training companies, from venture-backed start-ups to global brands, on growth strategy, institutional partnerships, organizational design, product development, learning design, and change management.

name: Karmela Gaffney
summaryHtml: Karmela is a senior marketing leader with more than twenty-five years of experience across strategy, brand development, and customer engagement. Read more.
bioHtml:
Currently serves as Chief Marketing Officer at APEI, with over twenty-five years of experience in marketing strategy, brand development, and customer engagement across Fortune 500 companies.

Previously served as Chief Marketing Officer at Academic Partnerships, where she led brand and product marketing, field sales, public relations, and research operations. Has also held senior roles at the University of Phoenix, Choice Hotels, and Best Western International. Holds a Bachelor of Arts in Journalism from Arizona State University.

name: Pavan Kumar, PhD
summaryHtml: Pavan is a researcher, entrepreneur, and business-builder focused on STEM education reform, workforce development, and innovation. Read more.
bioHtml:
A researcher, entrepreneur, and business-builder with a doctorate from the Erik Jonsson School of Engineering and Computer Science at the University of Texas at Dallas. Doctoral research focused on the investigation, alignment, measurement, and prediction of Engineering Identity among engineering undergraduates, examining how it evolves in students and the institutional forces that shape it.

A Graduate Fellow of the Archer Fellowship Program, which develops the next generation of leaders for local, state, federal, and international service across The University of Texas System. During doctoral studies, served as a Research Assistant in programs focused on AI and automation in manufacturing.

Has worked with governments and industry at multiple levels to implement systemic changes supporting STEM education and workforce development. Earlier career spans technical and managerial roles, founding and directing several high-impact organizations in India, championing the Maker Movement, and leading a billionaire philanthropist's nonprofit organization focused on innovation and impact in the healthcare sector.

name: Josh Summers, PhD
summaryHtml: Josh advises Cohort Science™ on strategic growth across education and partner ecosystems. Read more.
bioHtml:
Joshua D. Summers is Professor of Mechanical Engineering at the University of Texas at Dallas.

Dr. Summers is currently serving as Interim Associate Dean for Undergraduate Studies and formerly served as Department Head for Mechanical Engineering.

Dr. Summers earned his Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering from Arizona State University researching design automation. Dr. Summers received his BSME and MSME from the University of Missouri-Columbia working on VR-based submarine design. Dr. Summers has worked at the Naval Research Laboratory (VR Lab and Naval Center for Applied Research in Artificial Intelligence) and served on the Foreign Relations/Armed Services staff of Senator John D. Ashcroft. Dr. Summers' research has been funded (>$22M) by government (NASA, NSF, US Army TACOM), large industry (BMW, Michelin, General Motors), and small-medium sized enterprises (Wright Metal Products, Hartness International, and others).

Dr. Summers' areas of interest include collaborative design, knowledge management, and design enabler development with the overall objective of improving design through collaboration and computation. The work has resulted in over 350 peer reviewed publications.

Dr. Summers teaching interests has resulted in introduction of four new courses in engineering design, revamping of the senior design program, and the introduction of an international study abroad experience for senior engineers. This research and teaching has been recognized with awards from SAE (Ralph Teetor Award and Arch T. Colwell Merit Award), TMCE (Outstanding Researcher Award), Innovision (Innovations in Education), the Toshiba-Kos Ishii DFMLC Award (research contributions to Design for Manufacturing), the South Carolina Governor's Award for Scientific Awareness, and with election to Fellow status in ASME (2012). Most significantly, Dr. Summers has been the advisor of record for 6+ post-doctoral students, 16+ completed PHD dissertations, 60+MS theses, 11 MS projects, 2 honor's undergraduate thesis, and currently supervises over a dozen graduate and undergraduate students.

All of his former post-doctoral advisees and several PHD students are currently in academic positions at University of Georgia, Florida Poly, the Citadel, Clemson University, Texas State University, St. Louis University, North Texas University, Florida Tech, University of Maryland, and James Madison University. He formerly was Professor in Mechanical Engineering at Clemson University, co-directed the CEDAR Group (Clemson Engineering Design Applications and Research), was the Director of Graduate Studies, and was the Director for Educational Initiatives for the Center for Advanced Manufacturing.
